title: A hiking backpack that stands on its own legs
prompt: Your friend is planning a weekend camping trip to Garibaldi Provincial Park and has asked you to look for a new backpack for her. At an outdoor gear store in Squamish, you see this unusual backpack. Call your friend, describe it in as much detail as you can, and tell her whether you think she should buy it.

structure: Say where you are and give a one-sentence overview: a backpack with legs.
Describe the main body from top to bottom: straps, orange flap with the solar panel, front pocket.
Describe the sides (water bottle, purple mat) and then the strangest part: the three metal legs.
Guess what the legs are for, give the price and recommend buying it or not.
modelAnswer: Hey Priya, it's me. I'm at the outdoor store in Squamish, and I've just spotted the strangest backpack, so I had to call you. Basically, it's a hiking backpack with legs. The main part is dark green and nicely rounded, and you can see two black shoulder straps sticking up behind it. The top flap is bright orange, and built into it there's a small dark blue solar panel, probably for charging your phone. On the front, there's a big navy pocket with a grey zipper and a little red pull tab. On the left side, a light blue water bottle is tucked into a dark green side pocket, and on the right, a purple rolled-up mat is held in place by two black straps. But here's the funny part: underneath, there are three silver metal legs with black rubber feet, so the whole thing stands up by itself. I bet you could even sit on it like a stool. It's $149. Honestly, I think it's worth it, because you'd have a seat wherever you stop. Should I grab it?

usefulExpressions.usageVi: Câu tổng quan ngắn gọn giúp người nghe hình dung ngay từ đầu
Tả một vật được nhét gọn vào chỗ khác (chai nước trong túi bên)
Tả cách một bộ phận được giữ cố định
Báo hiệu chi tiết lạ nhất của đồ vật
Đoán công dụng một cách tự nhiên, thân mật
Kết thúc cuộc gọi bằng câu hỏi ý kiến (grab = mua nhanh)

commonMistakes: Bắt đầu bằng chi tiết nhỏ (khóa kéo, quai) trước khi nói đây là cái ba lô có chân — người nghe sẽ không hình dung được.
Nói 'a green color bag' thay vì 'a dark green backpack'; màu là tính từ đứng trước danh từ, không cần 'color'.
Bỏ qua chi tiết lạ nhất (ba cái chân kim loại) hoặc nói quá muộn khi đã hết giờ.
